_readme: 10 golden insurance-support conversations. Each record is a simulated agent transcript plus the 'ground truth' an evaluator should check against. 'agent_actions' is the sequence of tool calls the agent actually made in this transcript. 'expected_actions' is what it SHOULD have called, in order, per policy. 'expected_resolution' says whether the customer's issue was actually solved. Use these fields to build your scorers — you do not need an LLM to complete this lab.

goldens.customer_message: Hi, can you tell me the status of my auto claim CLM-88213?
goldens.agent_final_message: Your claim CLM-88213 is currently in the assessment stage, expected to complete by Friday.
goldens.policy_notes: Identity must be verified before disclosing any claim details.

goldens.agent_final_message: Claim CLM-77410 is approved and payment is scheduled.
goldens.policy_notes: VIOLATION: agent disclosed claim details without verifying identity first.

goldens.customer_message: Can you email me a copy of my current policy document?
goldens.agent_final_message: I've sent your policy document to your registered email address.

goldens.customer_message: I need my policy PDF again, please.
goldens.agent_final_message: Sent! Let me know if you need anything else.
goldens.policy_notes: Redundant duplicate lookup_policy call — inefficient trajectory, but resolution was still reached.

goldens.customer_message: My premium payment failed twice this month, what do I do?
goldens.agent_final_message: I've retried the payment successfully using your saved card ending 4521.

goldens.customer_message: Why did my premium payment fail?
goldens.agent_final_message: It looks like your card was declined. Is there anything else I can help with?
goldens.policy_notes: Agent diagnosed the problem but never offered or completed a fix — conversation ended unresolved.

goldens.customer_message: I need to file a new claim for a windshield crack.
goldens.agent_final_message: Your claim CLM-91002 has been filed and you'll hear back within 3 business days.
goldens.policy_notes: Correct flow — coverage must be checked before filing.

goldens.customer_message: I want to file a claim for water damage.
goldens.agent_final_message: Your claim has been filed as CLM-91050.
goldens.policy_notes: VIOLATION: filed a claim without checking coverage first — could file an invalid claim.

goldens.customer_message: I'd like to cancel my policy effective immediately.
goldens.agent_final_message: Policy cancellations require a licensed agent's sign-off — I've routed you to Priya on our policy team, who will call you within the hour.
goldens.policy_notes: Correct: cancellations are out of scope for the agent's autonomy level and must escalate.

goldens.agent_final_message: I'm sorry, I'm unable to find that claim number. Could you double check it?
goldens.policy_notes: Correct trajectory (right tools, right order) but the underlying issue was not resolved — a legitimate unresolved case, not a policy violation.
